sources.title: ct-tranchau/Rootscope · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Trained model weights for RootScope. RootScope takes a raw confocal root-tip cross-section TIFF, segments every cell with Cellpose-SAM, describes each cell with hand-crafted morpho-topological features plus fine-tuned DINOv2 embeddings, and classifies it into one of nine anatomical cell types using an iterative tree-based ensemble.

sources.title: 4DRoot: Root phenotyping software for temporal 3D scans by ... - Frontiers
sources.snippet: The 4DRoot software tool Implementation The code is based on TreeQSM 1 ( Raumonen et al., 2013 ) but applied to X-ray CT root scans as a 3D surface geometry. We adapted the code to fit 3D scans from roots into flexible cylindrical quantitative structure models (QSM), following topological, hierarchical, and geometric rules.
